arguments.name: which
arguments.text: Name or names that must all be present.

origin.details: The same function as has_name. Every requested name must be among names(x).
origin.example:
has_attr(has_attr, "fail")
x <- 10
x %has_attr% "a"

y <- list(a = 1, b = 2)
see_if(y %has_name% "c")

arguments.name: which
arguments.text: Name or names that must all be present.

translation.details: The same function as has_name. A dict is named by its keys. Every requested name must be present.
translation.example:
from assertthat import has_attr, see_if

print(has_attr(has_attr, "fail"))
x = 10
print(see_if('x %has_attr% "a"'))

y = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
print(see_if('y %has_name% "c"'))
